content: Self-love is more cunning than the most cunning man in the world.
author: François de La Rochefoucauld
sourceWork: Memoirs of the Regency of Anne of Austria
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. Genuine love is not a transaction where you keep score of who gave what; it is a state of being where you extend warmth and goodwill without needing to control the other person.

François de La Rochefoucauld understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. The biggest barrier to deep connection is never external; it is our own fear of rejection. We build armor around our hearts to avoid pain, but that same armor ends up locking out the warmth and intimacy we crave.
reflectionPrompt: How can acknowledging your vulnerability help you build deeper self-trust and inner peace?
